version_compatibility_test_matrix.description: Expected behavior for ESM format version compatibility testing. Re-based on esm 1.0.0: the library implements major version 1, so major 0 is REJECTED (the 1.0.0 break carries no deprecation path) and the backward/forward gradation this category exists to cover is expressed in 1.x fixtures. Each fixture declares the version it is NAMED for — these files exercise the version GATE, and a fixture restamped to the library's own version tests nothing.

0.x_to_1.0.0.summary: Unified variable model — `states` and `observed` collapse into one `unknown` type whose behaviour is stated by equations, the per-variable `expression` field is removed, `brownian` and `discrete` become parameters carrying a `distribution` / `update`, and `data_loaders` becomes `data_sources`, a pure ingest registry. A CLEAN BREAK: a 1.0.0 library rejects every 0.x document rather than migrating it. See esm-spec.md §6.3 and §8.5.
breaking_changes: Variable `type` admits exactly `unknown` and `parameter`; `state`, `observed`, `brownian` and `discrete` are removed with no deprecation path.
The per-variable `expression` field is removed. An observed unknown is DEFINED by the bare-variable-LHS equation whose LHS names it (esm-spec §6.3.1).
`brownian` becomes a parameter with `update: {kind: "wiener"}` and a `distribution`; `discrete` becomes a parameter with a schedule `update`.

Top-level `data_loaders` becomes `data_sources`, and a data source declares NO variables: a model reads a field by declaring a PARAMETER whose `update: {kind: "data", source, from: {file_variable}}` names it (esm-spec §8.5).
Parameter mutation moves out of `events` and onto the parameter's own `update` array.
added: The classification API — `ode_states`, `observed_unknowns`, `algebraic_unknowns`, `brownian_parameters`, `discrete_parameters`, `system_kind` — which every binding exposes so a consumer derives a variable's ROLE instead of reading a declared type.
`update` accepts an ARRAY of rules, so one parameter can be both data-fed and event-mutated.
migration_path: There is no automatic path: a 0.x document must be rewritten. The pair below shows what that looks like for one reaction system.
A `state` or `observed` variable becomes `"type": "unknown"`; an observed's `expression` becomes an equation `{"lhs": "<name>", "rhs": <expression>}`.
A `brownian` variable becomes a parameter with `"distribution"` and `"update": {"kind": "wiener"}`.
A `data_loaders` block becomes `data_sources` with its `variables` deleted; each consuming model declares the parameter that reads the field, with the units the loader used to carry.

test_cases.description: Exact version match - should load successfully
Same minor version, newer patch - fully compatible
Large patch number - should load successfully
Newer minor version - forward compatible with warning
warnings: File version 1.1.0 is newer than library version 1.0.0. Unknown fields will be ignored.

test_cases.description: Double-digit minor version - 1.10.0 is newer than 1.2.0, which a lexicographic comparison gets wrong
warnings: File version 1.10.0 is newer than library version 1.0.0. Unknown fields will be ignored.

test_cases.description: Newer minor carrying two top-level blocks this library does not model. esm-libraries-spec §8 asks a library to SKIP schema validation for a forward-compatible file so unknown fields are ignored; no binding implements that, and the schema's `additionalProperties: false` rejects the file before the forward-compatibility warning is reached. This case pins the behavior the five bindings actually share — see the OPEN note in README.md.
test_cases.error: Additional properties are not allowed ('performance_hints', 'validation_metadata' were unexpected)

Version as number instead of string - should fail validation
Prerelease identifier on an otherwise SUPPORTED version - the pattern admits major.minor.patch only, so this fails before the version gate sees it

migration_tests.description: Example of migrating a reaction system from version 0.0.5 across the 1.0.0 break. The SOURCE is unloadable by a 1.x library (wrong major) and the TARGET loads: that asymmetry is the point, because under a clean break migration is a rewrite a human performs, not something the loader does.
changes: Converted CH4 units from ppbv to mol/mol
Recorded the migration in metadata.description — `metadata` is a closed object, so a bespoke `migration_notes` key would make the migrated file itself invalid

validation_rules.major_version_compatibility: Libraries must reject files whose major version differs from their own, in EITHER direction. A 1.x library rejects 0.x and 2.x alike.
validation_rules.minor_version_backward_compatibility: Libraries must accept files with minor version <= their supported minor version, within the same major
validation_rules.minor_version_forward_compatibility: Libraries should warn but attempt to load files with minor version > their supported minor version, within the same major
validation_rules.patch_version_compatibility: Patch versions are fully compatible within the same major.minor
validation_rules.schema_validation: esm-libraries-spec §8 asks libraries to skip JSON Schema validation for forward-compatible files (newer minor versions). NOT IMPLEMENTED in any binding: the schema is applied to every document, so a newer minor carrying an unmodelled block is rejected. See the OPEN note in README.md.
validation_rules.unknown_field_handling: esm-libraries-spec §8 asks that unknown fields in a forward-compatible file be ignored silently. NOT IMPLEMENTED: the schema sets `additionalProperties: false` on every object, not only the document root, so a newer minor version cannot add a field at ANY level without the file becoming unreadable to this library. See `schema_validation` and the OPEN note in README.md.
validation_rules.version_comparison: Compare version components NUMERICALLY, never lexicographically: 1.10.0 is newer than 1.2.0, and 1.0.100 is a patch of 1.0, not a minor bump

error_codes.UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION: File major version is not supported by this library
error_codes.INVALID_VERSION_FORMAT: Version string does not match semver pattern
error_codes.SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR: File does not conform to JSON Schema
